title: Extensionality on all subopen wedges for internal exterior dual sections
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M an O_X-module sheaf, n a natural number, U an open, and q,r internal dual sections [def-pur-sheaf-hom] of the sheafified exterior power [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] on U. If q and r agree on every pure wedge of M(V) for every subopen V→U, then q=r.

source.place: Tags 03CY and 0BRT (determinant inversion); pairingDual and pairingDual_ιMulti_ιMulti. Expanded local argument written by N1; Stacks pages read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03CY and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BRT.

proof.text: Precompose each component with the exterior sheafification unit. The precomposed linear maps agree on pure wedges by hypothesis, hence agree by exteriorPower.linearMap_ext.

For an arbitrary section x over W→U, the image sieve of the sheafification unit on x covers W. On each arrow in that sieve choose a local preimage y. Naturality of q and r identifies their restricted values on x with their values on the unit image of y, which agree by the preceding step. Separatedness of the structure sheaf gives equality on x. Extensionality for presheaf module morphisms now gives q=r. Implemented with Presheaf.imageSieve_mem and the sheafification unit local-surjectivity instance.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheaf_dual_ext (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (U : X.Opens)
    (q r : (Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf M n)).val.obj (op U))
    (h : ∀ (V : X.Opens) (g : V ⟶ U) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op V)),
      q.app (op (Over.mk g)) (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection M n V a) =
        r.app (op (Over.mk g)) (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection M n V a)) :
    q = r
